Papou rides with his best friend to Kentucky

By mrogers September 17, 2025

Papou and his friend Mr. Todd rode our bikes to Kentucky and back for a small vacation trip.

Our travels took us from home to Glasgow Kentucky and all around the middle of the state!

We got to see so many sights from the Kentucky Stonehenge

to the place president Lincoln was born. We even went to see where Makers Mark Bourbon was made! (We didn't drink it!)

I hope you enjoy the video of our trip!
